title: What are the differences between for, while, and for...of loops?
expectedConcepts: Standard for loop with counter (init, condition, increment)
while loop executing as long as a condition holds
for...of loop iterating over values of an iterable (Arrays, Strings, Maps)
hints: Which loop provides direct access to array items without fruits[i]?
When would a while loop be preferred over a for loop?

codingExercise.instruction: Write a function sumArray(numbers) that uses a for...of loop to compute and return the sum of an array of numbers.
